senses.gloss:
Udbalīya_(?)
--C. on Rāmāyaṇa. Mistake for Ahobalīya ? See NCC. I. p. 355b, Ahobala, C. on Rāmāyaṇa. Viśvabhāratī 2705 (Uttarakāṇḍa).

Udbāhupūrvakārikā
Āśval. prayoga. MT. 3162 (c). This seems to refer to a Pūrvakārikā by a writer named Udbāhusaumya or U. sundara or by a pupil of his (see v. 2; udbAhusaumyaM viduSAM variSTham etc.).

Udbāhusundara
of Col. country, father of Divākara (a. of the play Lakṣmīmānaveda on a Zamorin of Calicut). MT. 4319.

Udbodhacandrikā
jy. Dacca 2152. L. 596. SK. Ray 423 (inc.). Same a. next ? [Page340-b]

Udbodhacandrikā
jy. by Rāmakṛṣṇacakravartī. Skt. Col.. Ben. 1902, p. 3 (no. 1006).

Udbodhikā
name of C. by Viśvapatitīrtha on Madhvavijayapadārthadīpikā. MD. 12161 (inc.).
